cards.verse_text: And Jesus said to him, “Truly I tell you, today you will be with Me in Paradise.”
cards.snippet: …him, “Truly I tell you, today you will be with Me in Paradise.”

cards.card_text: And he says this man was caught up to Paradise.
cards.verse_text: And I know that this man—whether in the body or out of it I do not know, but God knows— was caught up to Paradise.
cards.snippet: …it I do not know, but God knows— was caught up to Paradise.

cards.card_text: Paul says the man was free to tell others the things he heard in Paradise.
In the Paradise of God, they'll have the right to eat from what?
cards.verse_text: To the one who overcomes, I will grant the right to eat from the tree of life in the Paradise of God.
cards.snippet: …grant the right to eat from the tree of life in the Paradise of God.
